prOriginal.nota: Found by gh search on 'AuthzClientCryptoProvider'. Single PR commit is the benchmark head 79d11c48; squash commit b95d12a9 on main touches the same 12 files with the same line counts. Backported to release/26.0 as #34003.

add-authzclientcryptoprovider-for-author.reason: CryptoProvider.java on main still declares `int order();` with no default, and CryptoIntegration.detectProvider still sorts every ServiceLoader provider with Comparator.comparingInt(CryptoProvider::order). Later commits to CryptoProvider (#43432 import order, RSA 3072, BCFKS truststore) did not add a default.

CryptoIntegration.detectProvider on main is unchanged: sorts by order() and returns the first, only logging ignored providers, with no tie/multiple-provider error. DefaultCryptoProvider, FIPS1402Provider and WildFlyElytronProvider all still return 200 from order().

ECDSAAlgorithmTest on main still builds one KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("EC").genKeyPair() (default curve) in the constructor and reuses it for ES256/ES384/ES512. Only change after merge was the import-order commit #43432.

ECDSAAlgorithmTest.test on main still asserts only assertArrayEquals(rsConcat, rsConcat2) after a decode/encode/decode round trip, never comparing asn1Des to the original signature nor calling Signature.verify.
